description_en: Queries whether a specified directory contains Infrequent Access (IA) storage class or Archive storage class files, or queries whether a specified file is an IA storage class or Archive storage class file
description_zh: 查询指定目录下是否包含低频存储和归档存储文件，或者查询指定文件是否为低频存储或归档存储文件
name: GetDirectoryOrFileProperties

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of the specified directory.

The path must start with a forward slash (/) and must be an existing path in the mount target
parameters.help_zh:
指定目录的绝对路径。

必须以正斜线（/）开头，并且是挂载点中真实存在的路径
parameters.name: path

ATime.description_en:
The time when the file was queried.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

This parameter is returned only when Type is File
ATime.description_zh:
查询时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数

CTime.description_en:
The time when the metadata was modified.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

This parameter is returned only when Type is File
CTime.description_zh:
元数据修改时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

仅当Type为File时，返回该值参数

HasArchiveFile.description_en:
Indicates whether the directory contains Archive storage class files.

This parameter is returned only when Type is Directory.

Valid values:

true: The directory contains Archive storage class files.
false: The directory does not contain Archive storage class files
HasArchiveFile.description_zh:
是否包含归档存储文件。

仅当Type为Directory时，返回该参数。

包括：

true：包含
false：不包含

HasInfrequentAccessFile.description_en:
Indicates whether the directory contains IA storage class files.

This parameter is returned only when Type is Directory.

Valid values:

true: The directory contains IA storage class files.
false: The directory does not contain IA storage class files
HasInfrequentAccessFile.description_zh:
是否包含低频存储文件。

仅当Type为Directory时，返回该参数。

包括：

true：包含
false：不包含

Inode.description_en: The inode of the file or directory

MTime.description_en:
The time when the file was modified.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

This parameter is returned only when Type is File
MTime.description_zh:
文件修改时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数

Name.description_en: The file name or directory name

OfflineDuration.description_en: The total duration for which the file has been stored as an Archive file. Unit: seconds
OfflineDuration.description_zh: 转储为归档文件的总时长。单位：秒

OfflineUnchangedDuration.description_en: The total duration for which the file has remained unchanged since it was stored as an Archive file. Unit: seconds
OfflineUnchangedDuration.description_zh: 转储为归档文件后文件距今未被改动的总时长。单位：秒

RetrieveTime.description_en:
The time when the most recent data retrieval task was executed.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

This parameter is returned only when Type is File
RetrieveTime.description_zh:
距现在最近一次数据取回任务执行的时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数

Size.description_en:
The size of the file.

Unit: bytes.

This parameter is returned only when Type is File
Size.description_zh:
文件的大小。

单位：字节

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type of the returned file.

This parameter is returned only when Type is File.

Valid values:

Standard: General-purpose NAS storage.
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class
StorageType.description_zh:
返回文件的数据存储类型。

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数。

包括：

Standard：通用型NAS存储。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储

Type.description_en:
The type of the returned result.

Valid values:

File: file
Directory: directory
Type.description_zh:
返回结果的类型。

包括：

File：文件
Directory：目录
